title: Add LDBC complex-query isolation matrix coverage

steps.step: Continue from BENCHPROD-114 final frontier: 80-op smoke did not force every complex query in one reproducible evidence artifact
Inspect ldbc_snb_native_smoke.py for existing isolation controls and command-mode report artifacts
Create an independent ldbc_snb_complex_matrix.py wrapper around the existing native smoke harness
Run a representative Q4/Q6/Q10/Q14 matrix subset to validate recent optimization, prior Q6 gap, Q10 regression guard, and Q14 frontier
Run full Q1-Q14 complex-query isolation matrix and capture per-query metrics
Record evidence conservatively as command-mode isolation matrix, not a full official LDBC pass

verification: python -m py_compile ldbc_snb_complex_matrix.py ldbc_snb_native_smoke.py external_bootstrap.py: passed

result.matrix_scope: command-mode isolation matrix; each case enables exactly one LDBC complex query and disables the other complex queries plus all short reads

remaining_blockers: This is not a full official LDBC benchmark pass.
Each matrix case is an isolation run, so it proves per-query command-mode coverage but not official mixed scheduling semantics.
Updates remain disabled in the underlying generated LDBC properties.
Short reads are intentionally disabled in matrix cases.
Native memtier remains blocked by missing real memtier_benchmark tooling.
next_task: BENCHPROD-116 candidate: wire the LDBC complex matrix into production gate profiles, or add an equivalent coverage matrix for another target suite such as TSBS or CH-benCHmark.
